summary: Diff implements safer, repeatable backend access-control initialization and adds frontend-side backend-readiness checks/toasts, but the diff summary does not provide enough evidence that the Books List UI now always opens the create-book dialog during actor initialization, nor that the required initialization loading/error banner UI (with Retry) is rendered near the “Add book” button. Translations were expanded, but the summary is truncated and does not confirm all required keys exist for both English and Polish (notably theme.toggle / language.* in both languages).

missing_requirements.requirement: Books List: “Add book” button always responds (opens create-book dialog) even while backend actor is initializing; prevent final Create action until backend ready and show actionable error when not ready.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows logic to block the create action when backend is not ready (toast + retry), but the truncated BooksListPage snippet does not show the DialogTrigger/Button rendering to confirm the “Add book” trigger is never disabled/inert while the actor is initializing and that clicking it always opens the dialog.

missing_requirements.requirement: Books List: show backend initialization indicator near “Add book” while actor is fetching; if actor init fails (actor null after fetch), show inline error banner with Retry that invalidates/refetches actor query.
missing_requirements.reason: State/handlers for actorFetching/showActorError and handleRetryActor(invalidateQueries) exist, but the diff summary does not show JSX rendering a visible loading indicator near the button or an inline error banner with Retry control.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update LanguageContext translations to include all specified keys used by login/header/books list (at minimum: books.new, books.myBooks, books.subtitle, books.empty, books.titleRequired, books.creating, general.loading, app.title, login.subtitle, login.connecting, login.privacy, login.loggedOut, language.english, language.polish, theme.toggle) with English and Polish values.
missing_requirements.reason: LanguageContext diff is truncated and only shows a portion of the Polish map; it does not confirm that (a) the English map contains all required keys, and (b) specific required keys like language.english/language.polish/theme.toggle are present in both languages.
